name: Nuclear envelope and pore complex disassembly and reassembly
rationale: All members concern nuclear envelope and nuclear pore complex organization, chiefly their mitotic breakdown and rebuilding (lamina depolymerization, NPC disassembly/reassembly), which separates it from ESCRT-mediated sealing and from nucleocytoplasmic transport/SUMOylation neighbours.

name: Podocyte and glomerular filtration barrier development
rationale: Members cover podocyte nephrin interactions, migration, cytoskeleton, basement membrane and albumin handling, distinguishing it from mesangial/endothelial glomerulus development and generic epithelial polarity neighbours.

name: Dietary carbohydrate digestion and hexose transmembrane transport
rationale: Members share sugar handling via disaccharide digestion and SLC2/SLC5 hexose transporters, unlike neighbours focused on urate/amino acid transporters or galactose/fructose catabolism.

name: FGFR1 and FGFR2 isoform activation and downstream signaling
rationale: Members are FGFR1/FGFR2 splice-isoform ligand activation, mutants and their FRS/SHC/PLC/PI3K cascades, whereas confusables center on FGFR3 and FGFR4.

name: LDL receptor endocytosis and degradation controlling cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members concern lipoprotein receptor internalization, recycling and lysosomal degradation with sterol feedback on uptake and synthesis, distinct from HDL/efflux and SREBP-activation neighbours.

name: Fc-epsilon receptor-triggered mast cell activation and degranulation
rationale: Members are FCERI signaling outputs (Ca2+, MAPK, NF-kB) leading to mast cell degranulation, histamine and cytokine release, unlike neighbours on mast cell differentiation/inhibition, Fc-gamma signaling or Th2 cytokines.

qualifier: RAS GTPase regulation by GEFs and GAPs
name: RAS GTPase regulation and RAF activation
rationale: Members span SOS/GAP control of RAS, RAS/GAP disease mutants and RAF activation, differing from neighbours on ERK feedback inactivation and BRAF/RAF1 oncogenic mutants.

name: Germ cell development and oocyte meiotic maturation
rationale: Members cover primordial germ cell migration, proliferation and death plus meiosis activation and oocyte maturation, separating it from follicle, germline stem cell and testis neighbours.

name: Skin appendage, hair follicle and melanocyte development
rationale: Members are ectoderm-derived appendages (hair follicle, sebaceous, mammary, nail, papilla) with melanocyte expansion, unlike keratinocyte/cornification and tooth neighbours.

name: Monocyte trafficking and negative regulation of leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members combine CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte trafficking modules with inhibition of monocyte, macrophage and T cell migration and chemokine signaling, whereas neighbours emphasize chemokine ligands and positive monocyte recruitment.

name: SRP-dependent and tail-anchored protein insertion into ER
rationale: Members are co- and post-translational targeting and membrane insertion of proteins into the ER, distinguishing it from ERAD/quality control and COPII export neighbours.

name: p53- and FOXO-driven G1 arrest and quiescence
rationale: Members concern TP53/FOXO transcription of cell cycle inhibitors like p21 and G0/G1 transitions, unlike neighbours on p53-driven apoptosis, p14ARF loss or retinoic acid signaling.

name: Vascular smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
rationale: All members address arterial smooth muscle tone and vasoconstriction, while neighbours center on renin-angiotensin, NO-cGMP or alpha-2 adrenergic signaling.

name: NT-3 signaling through NTRK3 and NTRK2
rationale: Members are NTF3-activated TRKC/TRKB signaling via RAS, PI3K and PLCG1, distinct from NGF-TRKA and BDNF-TRKB neighbours.

qualifier: Rac-driven ruffling and early endosome trafficking
name: Rac-driven ruffling, macropinocytosis and early endosome trafficking
rationale: Members share actin protrusion-based uptake (ruffles, podosomes, Rac, DAP12) and early endosome routing, unlike Rho GTPase cycle and clathrin/caveolin endocytosis neighbours.

name: Cation-chloride cotransport and potassium channel ion homeostasis
rationale: Members are SLC12 cotransporters, K+ channels (KCa, TASK) and Na+/K+ transport regulation, distinguishing it from magnesium/paracellular and osmotic-stress/NHE neighbours.

name: Glucagon-PKA signaling and gluconeogenesis control
rationale: Members share glucagon response, PKA activation and regulation of gluconeogenesis, unlike neighbours on insulin secretion, glycogen metabolism or insulin/adiponectin signaling.

name: Postsynaptic ionotropic glutamate receptor signaling and excitatory transmission
rationale: Members concern AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor activation, clustering and excitatory transmission, distinct from plasticity/CREB, receptor recycling and presynaptic neighbours.

name: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and pre-replicative complex formation
rationale: Members are E2F target transcription and ORC/CDC6 pre-RC assembly, separating it from broad cell-cycle modules and replication-stress/ATR neighbours.

name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain and branched fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members are peroxisomal beta- and alpha-oxidation of VLCFA, pristanate and phytanate and polyunsaturated fatty acids, unlike mitochondrial short/medium-chain and VLCFA synthesis neighbours.

name: Pyruvate, dicarboxylate and tricarboxylate organic anion transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of carboxylate anions (pyruvate, succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, citrate), distinguishing it from malate-aspartate shuttle and organic cation neighbours.

name: Phosphate homeostasis in skeletal, dental and ectopic mineralization
rationale: Members link phosphate transport and homeostasis to bone, enamel and dentin mineralization and ectopic calcification disorders, unlike FGF23-Klotho/type II Na-Pi and bone maturation neighbours.

name: Fructose, polyol and glucuronate-xylulose metabolism
rationale: Members cover fructose catabolism, alditol metabolism and the glucuronate-to-xylulose pentose route, distinguishing it from galactose Leloir and pentose phosphate shunt neighbours.

name: Lysine acetylation, KMT2 methylation and AP-2 factor regulation
rationale: Members share histone/protein lysine acetylation and KMT2/WDR5 histone methylation, and uniquely include TFAP2 activity regulation that separates it from broad chromatin-remodeling neighbours.

core: Neural progenitor division and neuron differentiation
name: Neural progenitor division and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation
rationale: Members cover neural progenitor/radial glia division and differentiation with midbrain dopaminergic and cerebellar specialization, unlike neural stem cell maintenance, oligodendrocyte and axon guidance neighbours.
